summary: Register RUTUBE as a Social Core video provider through an account-specific typed official-partner transport, with exact channel binding, Task-088 released MP4 upload, processing-status reconciliation and fail-closed quota/ambiguous-write handling without guessed private endpoints or Core changes.

impacts.evidence: One tenant-bound Account resolves one exact RUTUBE ChannelID and one non-secret partner ContractID; health/publication/status reject foreign channel identities.
Partner credential bytes remain Task-021 callback-scoped; video bytes are opened only from a current Task-088 released UploadID immediately before upload.
Task 046 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP/OpenAPI operation.
Task 046 consumes existing SocialPublisher and SocialPublicationStatusReader surfaces; frozen Connector/Runtime SDK-v1 roots and Core remain unchanged.
No migration is added; ChannelID, ContractID, upload-session and video identities remain provider-boundary data.

Provider code contains no guessed RUTUBE HTTP path, Studio cookie, CSRF token, DOM automation or reverse-engineered private RPC. Production egress is delegated only to a typed host PartnerTransport bound to the tenant's current official account-specific partner contract.
Only social.post.video is declared. Comments, analytics, edit/delete, native scheduling, streams, monetization and other unqualified surfaces remain absent from the manifest.
Task-020 remains canonical Content/Variant/Publication owner; canonical PublicationID is propagated as the partner external ID and only bounded channel/video status returns to Core.
Create-upload, byte-upload and commit are an explicit state machine. Quota is normalized; ambiguous upload/commit outcomes fail closed and require reconciliation rather than a blind second session.
Task 046 adds no inbound webhook surface; processing state is reconciled through bounded status reads.
Authentication, permission, quota, rate-limit, rejection, missing-resource, unavailable and ambiguous-write failures are normalized without raw partner responses or credentials.
Suspend the RUTUBE connector account and revoke its partner credential/transport contract binding to stop publication; no schema rollback is required.

Deterministic tests cover manifest parity, exact channel health, upload/status state transitions, Task-088 media validation, quota/rate-limit normalization, foreign-channel rejection and ambiguous write handling; Task-064 provider admission is required.
